clock.gate: every busy nvidia-smi sample (50 ms) >= 1980 MHz; a window without busy samples requires every sample >= boost

derived_model.full_chip_tile_store_note: 132 CTAs x 65536 B bulk shared->global store: shell with store minus the store-free shell of the same geometry
derived_model.launch_shell_note: median of the store-free shells over the four in-scope launch geometries (grid 132; 256/384 threads; 150-225 KiB dynamic shared memory; cluster 1/2)

ring_service_model.fit_rule: grid search minimising the squared log error of the steady (two largest k-block) per-stage slopes; fill by least squares over the steady intercepts
ring_service_model.form: interval = (floor^p + (streaming_ctas * weight_box_bytes / bandwidth)^p)^(1/p); duration = fill_base + fill_per_store_byte * store_bytes + kblocks * interval

derived_model.rule: median over trials of the per-trial median nsys kernel duration; consumers interpolate piecewise-linearly in streaming CTAs and k-blocks (no fitted form)

wgmma_probe_not_published.reason: isolated shared-memory-operand FP8 wgmma throughput exceeds the public H200 dense FP8 rate (1978.9 TFLOP/s, 7571 FLOP/cycle/SM at 1.98 GHz) and a smoke variant rotating the operands over 4-6 stage buffers ran 1.7x slower than the fixed-buffer probe, so the probe does not isolate the production tensor mechanism; the template uses the public FP8 rate of the HWSpec tensor_core component instead
